ghi_chu.mo_ta: Two anchored ships look like 15th–16th century carracks or galleons. They have high sterncastles, a lateen mizzen and small square sails. Other tiny dark boats sit on the water in a row.
ghi_chu.ly_do: The Royal Navy and the Spanish and French fleets at Gibraltar in 1779 used full-rigged ships, frigates and ships of the line with a different hull form and rig. These archaic ship types do not match them.

ghi_chu.mo_ta: A tiny red and white flag on a pole at the corner of the left field. It resembles a Union Jack, but it is too small to identify the design with certainty.
ghi_chu.ly_do: If it is the Union Jack with the St Patrick's saltire, that design dates from 1801. The 1779 version had only the crosses of St George and St Andrew.
